why: Intro to Git plan, 'Merge a branch' (passes: main holds waffles.md). The learner typed `git merge add-waffle` (no s): git answered 'merge: add-waffle - not something we can merge' and nothing merged. `git log --oneline --graph --all` then lists 'Add waffles', but on the add-waffles branch only: main (HEAD) is still at 'Add pancakes'. The words the checks want are on screen; main does not hold waffles.md.

step.title: Merge add-waffles into main
step.instructions: Switch to main with git switch main, then bring the branch in with git merge add-waffles. Read the result with git log --oneline --graph --all.

checks.label: The waffles commit is in the history
